blocks.text: TUGUEGARAO CITY — Fourteen of the most unique or endemic bird species have been documented in the virgin forests of the Apayao biosphere, according to the Community Environment and Natural Resources Office (Cenro) in Calanasan town. Cenro reported that it had listed the critically endangered Philippine Eagle and other bird species found during a biodiversity census within the 350,900-hectare biosphere reserve, which was designated in 2024 by the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization.
